town.title: Moonlight Foxstar needs a second opinion
town.text: "This town's collision boxes are off. Or the town is. Come and tell me which, NPC." - Moonlight Foxstar
town.arrive: You had a look round town.

forest.title: Something in the forest
forest.text: "The pond's gone quiet. Would you go and see?" - Mote

lake.title: Pete saw something in the lake
lake.text: "Something big, under the surface. Go and have a look, I'm not going back alone." - Pete
lake.arrive: You went down to the lake.

nature.title: Are the wildflowers out?
nature.text: "Walk the nature trail for me and tell me what's blooming." - Janis

mountains.title: Rocks on the mountain path
mountains.text: "Heard a fall up there last night. Make sure the path's clear." - Derrick

quarry.title: Derrick left a tool behind
quarry.text: "Left my good spade at the quarry. Just check nobody's walked off with it." - Derrick
quarry.arrive: The spade is where Derrick left it.

hotsprings.title: Is the spring steaming?
hotsprings.text: "The hot springs steam when the weather turns. Go and see if it has." - Vesper

witch.title: Rue wonders if you remember the way
witch.text: "Nobody comes up to the clearing any more. Prove me wrong." - Rue

library.title: A book set aside
library.text: "I've kept one back for you. It won't wait forever." - Quire

museum.title: The museum looks lonely
museum.text: "Nobody's been in for days. Go and keep the display case company." - Tally
museum.arrive: You looked in on the museum.

observatory.title: Clear skies tonight
observatory.text: "Come up to the observatory. You'll want to see this." - Vesper
observatory.arrive: You climbed up to the observatory.

bakery.title: Sabine wants an opinion
bakery.text: "New loaf. Needs a taster. Come by the bakery." - Sabine
bakery.arrive: You dropped in at the bakery.

shop.title: Something new at Fresh Finds
shop.text: "Got something on the shelf you haven't seen. Come and look." - Fig

tally_nest.title: A curious thing at the Shiny Shelf
tally_nest.text: "I can't place it. You might. Come by." - Tally

cc.title: A hand at the community center
cc.text: "The place needs airing out. Come and help me open the windows." - Missy
cc.arrive: You helped air out the community center.

bathhouse.title: The bathhouse is warm again
bathhouse.text: "Finally got the boiler going. Come and see." - Luke
bathhouse.arrive: You looked in on the bathhouse.

talk: "Come find me when you have a minute."
"I've been meaning to ask you something."
